description: Two stage analogue function generator, working as an envelope, an LFO or a slew limiter

params.text: Points the GATE output at the attack stage or at the release stage
Sets the contour, linear on the left and a logarithmic attack with exponential release on the right
Sets the onset duration of the function, and its lamp brightens while the voltage climbs
Sets the time the function takes to fall back to its starting voltage, and its lamp brightens while the voltage falls
Left is attack sustain release, the centre is attack release, and the right loops the function with cycle times from about 1ms to about 20 seconds
Fires the function by hand, and flips the charge direction of the core

inputs.text: A trigger or gate fires the function; in ASR mode a control voltage here is slewed by the attack and release settings
Shifts the attack time, summed with its fader
Shifts the release time, summed with its fader

outputs.text: The function as a bipolar voltage, 10Vpp
The function as a unipolar positive voltage, 0-10V
A 1ms 10V trigger at the end of each cycle
A 10V gate held for the attack stage or the release stage, whichever the stage gate toggle points at
